entries.german: ernennt Ulrich v. Rosenberg, Wenzel v. Duba, Unterkämmerer, u. Peter v. Sternberg zu Hauptleuten des Prachiner u. Bechiner Kreises. Per d. Mixonem de Gemisscz magistrum monete Michael canon. Prag. ─ o. R
entries.english: He appoints Ulrich von Rosenberg, Wenzel von Duba, Unterkämmerer, and Peter von Sternberg as captains of the Prachin and Bechin districts. By mandate of the Roman king, through Mixon of Gemisscz, mint master; Michael, canon of Prague. No register entry.
